about.title: Protecting Our Oceans, Empowering Our Communities
paragraphs: Tanzania's coasts, lakes and ports support millions of livelihoods, yet seafarers, fishers and coastal women and youth are too often left out of the blue economy.

Maritime Empowerment Organization (MEO) works to change that. We strengthen the skills, financial inclusion, safety and leadership of seafarers and coastal communities, through training, partnerships, advocacy and applied innovation.
about.vision: A resilient, inclusive blue economy where seafarers, coastal communities and maritime institutions thrive through decent work, innovation, safety and ocean stewardship.
about.mission: To advance equitable blue economy development by strengthening the skills, financial inclusion, safety and leadership of seafarers and coastal communities, through evidence-based work on sustainable fisheries, ocean conservation and climate-resilient livelihoods.
about.imageAlt: MEO presenting at a maritime exhibition

feature.title: WE4D: Women in the Green Transformation
feature.text: In November 2024, with COFAD and GIZ, MEO implemented Women's Employment for Africa's Green Transformation in Pemba, Zanzibar, reaching 358 participants across the seaweed value chain.
